|birth = {{ne|806}}}}'''Elaiva Walfor''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]]{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elaiva Walfor}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Elaiva is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|25}}. She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a [[Traveling|gateway]] of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

==History==
Elaiva was born in Andor in {{ne|806}}. She went to the White Tower in {{ne|822}} at the age of sixteen.

She spent ten years as a novice and eight years as an Accepted, being raised to the shawl in {{ne|840}}. She would have been novice together with [[Merise Haindehl]].

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

She was part of the White Tower's secret expedition who were to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of [[Dumai's Wells]] by the [[Asha'man]]{{ref/book|6|55}}.

Elaiva was one of the captured Aes Sedai{{ref/book|7|1}} to be interrogated by [[Verin Mathwin]] in order to discover the White Tower's intentions towards [[Rand al'Thor]]{{ref/book|8|p}}. In reality Verin used her mild [[Compulsion]] to implant in their minds some instructions about Rand.

Later it is reported by [[Sorilea]] that all the Aes Sedai prisoners have sworn fealty to Rand{{ref/book|9|13}}.

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Elaiva probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]]{{ref/book|14|34}}. It is not stated whether she survived or not.

==Trivia==
Elaiva Walfor is described only in ''The Wheel of Time Companion'', she is never mentioned in the main books of ''The Wheel of Time''. 

Her Ajah contradicts a statement by Galina stating that those sent to take control of Rand al'Thor consisted of only Reds, Greens and Whites, barring [[Coiren Saeldain]] and [[Nesune Bihara]]. While Galina is Black Ajah and thus able to lie, she has no reason to about this.
